study: India Label Index, study 10: the FSSAI test scoreboard
population_basis: Census 2011 (A-1 table, Office of the Registrar General). Telangana = its 10 districts of 2011 Andhra Pradesh; Ladakh = Leh and Kargil districts; Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu summed. Rates are per million 2011 residents, so they overstate today's per-head testing a little everywhere (India has grown about 17% since 2011).
rank_rule: a state or UT is ranked on a share only if it analysed at least 1000 samples in the period
